content.text:
I'd pick the second one, ב, with the lines. Every number sits right next to its words, so I read "המעסיק הוסיף +54,000 ₪" on one line from the right. In the first one, א, the number is at the top of the column and the words are at the bottom, and I kept looking up and down to match them. Still, I'm not fully convinced either way. I'd ask you or the bank whether the קרן השתלמות is worth it.

**What I looked at, in order:**
1. The title "קרן השתלמות: הסיפור של הכסף, שלב אחרי שלב". I know the keren from my years at work, so I stayed.
2. The small picture on the right with "מה היה". It was too small, so I left it.
3. The paragraph that starts "הדוגמה: שכר ברוטו 12,000 ₪". It's full of "S&P500", "מדד", "קרן ״ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" and numbers in brackets. I skipped it. It made me feel this isn't meant for someone like me.
4. Option א, which carries a "מומלץ" tag. The first number that stayed with me was "18,000 ₪", then "+54,000 ₪". Then I saw "−13,974 ₪" in red stripes under "המס לקח", and it frightened me. The last white column, "נשאר בידיים 66,513 ₪", I understood.
5. The second chart of א, for year 6, where "המס לקח 0 ₪". So after 6 years there's no tax. That was the one thing I really took from the page.
6. Option ב. It shows the same thing but as rows, with the name on the right and the number under it. It's easier, and the end, "נשאר בידיים 66,513 ₪", is in bold.

**What I didn't understand:**
- "מסלול מדד", "S&P500", "דמי ניהול 0.54%" and "תשואה 7%".
- The coloured bars with numbers 1 to 12 at the top of each chart. I didn't try to read them.
- I wasn't sure what the striped pink means. Maybe it's the tax.

**What I couldn't read:**
- The grey lines at the bottom, "בין 19 המסלולים שנאספו…" and "הגובה נמתח בכל שנה…". They're small and pale on a black background.
- The orange text in the example paragraph.

**What tired or bothered me:**
- The whole screen is black, crowded with numbers, and every chart repeats "קרן השתלמות במסלול מדד. 300 ₪ בחודש מכם, 900 ₪ מהמעסיק." I read it again each time.
- I don't know who "ילין לפידות" is.
- By the end of the second screen I was tired, and I would have stopped there.
